हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: The Silent Bull follows Kabir Malhotra, a disgraced mathematical prodigy hiding as a janitor who utilizes his superhuman calculation skills to rescue his love, Ananya, from a ruthless criminal underworld. To pay a massive ransom, Kabir infiltrates the high-stakes stock market, turning a single rupee into a billion-crore fortune through ghost trading and complex algorithms. After striking a desperate deal with a cold corporate CEO, he systematically dismantles his enemies’ financial empires
